ato.component.title: Avatar Texture Optimizer
ato.component.description: Analyses every mesh on this avatar, rebuilds UV islands at a perceptual quality target and repacks them into shared atlases.
ato.field.qualityTier:tooltip: Higher quality keeps more pixels. 'Lossless' skips all island rescaling and copies textures verbatim.
ato.field.generateAtlas:tooltip: When off, unused UV space is kept, UVs are not repacked, and textures are only rescaled as a whole.
ato.field.npot:tooltip: Steps atlas side length by 64 px instead of powers of two. Unsupported compression formats are removed automatically.
ato.field.mipmap:tooltip: VRChat requires Streaming Mip Maps whenever mip maps exist, so these are bound to a single toggle.
ato.error.multipleComponents: More than one Avatar Texture Optimizer component was found on this avatar.
ato.error.multipleComponents:description: Exactly one component is allowed per avatar, including all children. Remove the extra components and bake again.
ato.error.multipleComponents:hint: Search the hierarchy for 'Avatar Texture Optimizer' and delete all but one.
ato.error.noDescriptor: Avatar Texture Optimizer must be placed on a GameObject with a VRCAvatarDescriptor.
ato.error.noDescriptor:description: The component was found on a child object that has no avatar descriptor, so the bake was aborted.
ato.error.noDescriptor:hint: Move the component to the avatar root.
ato.error.internal: Avatar Texture Optimizer failed with an internal error.
ato.error.internal:description: The avatar was left untouched. Please report this together with the console log.
ato.error.internal:hint: Enable verbose logging on the component to capture more detail.
ato.warn.uvOutOfRange: Mesh '{0}' material slot {1} has UVs outside [0,1] that cross a wrap seam. Its textures were skipped.
ato.warn.shaderUnknown: Shader '{0}' could not be analysed safely. Its textures were treated as whitelisted.
ato.warn.textureTransform: Texture '{0}' is used with a non-identity ST / scroll / UV-mode on material '{1}'. Skipped.
ato.warn.tooLargeForAtlas: Texture '{0}' does not fit in the largest candidate atlas even alone. Its UV group was not atlased.
ato.warn.formatDowngraded: Format for '{0}' was downgraded to '{1}' because the content requires more channels.
ato.warn.npotFormatRemoved: Compression format '{0}' is unavailable for NPOT atlases on {1} and was replaced.
ato.warn.aaoMissing: Avatar Optimizer is not installed, UV evacuation was skipped.
ato.warn.cancelled: Bake was cancelled by the user. Temporary assets were kept on disk.
ato.report.title: Avatar Texture Optimizer
